blocks.text: SOP: pack station 6 through 11, dry outbound

This is the working cut for PCF-1188 on November 28, 2023. Tasha Quinn asked for a written bound after the current path (Packers tape when the line is loud, scale is optional on smalls) stopped being honest. I am Jeilen Jones, Order Picker, writing for Marcus Hale, Tasha Quinn, and Ben Crowe. Primary host pack.pinecrest.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on tape first, scale later, then open questions. If you are on the floor next shift, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the steps.

Scan tote, scan each unit, scan carton, scale must match ±0.12 lb. No tape until the scale is green. I am not restating a hallway yes. tape first, scale later is out because November 8 taped 41 cartons then scaled. 6 were light. Two already left the dock. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: stations=6, tol=0.12, light=6, taped=41, dock=2, weeks=2, units=3.8, fail=1.4. Sibling tickets PCF-SOP-2023-022 and PCF-1188-QA. I will not reopen tape first, scale later in a side thread because someone asked for a rate waiver. Tasha Quinn is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.
Decision for leadership

blocks.text: Scan tote, scan each unit, scan carton, scale must match ±0.12 lb. No tape until the scale is green.

Ticket PCF-1188 names the pull. If those numbers moved after November 28, 2023, update this file in review, do not 'correct' them in a group chat.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Ben Crowe owns a leftover that is easy to skip: scale-06.pinecrest.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (02): refuse on tape first, scale later, lock is scale green before tape, ±0.12 lb, stations 6-11. I will not hide a process change inside a 'quick align' on PCF-SOP-2023-022.
A closed carton with the wrong label is not packed. It is a reship.

What a skeptical lead would try first on pack.pinecrest.internal: the path Tasha Quinn actually has, not an empty-tote photo. Metric I will argue is a clean confirm, not a vanity units-per-hour. If we cannot show that path on wms.pinecrest.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Jeilen Jones will not accept a hallway yes as that proof.
Constraints and the lock
